disease_state.evidence: Here, we present an in-depth proteomic profiling of pre-diagnostic plasma samples from 114 individuals with suspected lung cancer, including 57 patients diagnosed with stage III-IV lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and 57 non-cancer controls.
The present study cohort includes 114 patients, with an equal number of patients diagnosed with either lung cancer or no cancer, i.e., other benign lung conditions.

sample_source.evidence: Plasma samples were depleted of high-abundant proteins, and proteomic analysis was performed using high-resolution isoelectric focusing (HiRIEF) coupled with liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), with relative quantification by isobaric tandem mass tags (TMT16-plex).

sex.evidence: DAAs between females (N = 37) and males (N = 51) were performed using a two-sided Welch’s t test, with males as the reference group.
